Q5650.reason: IIED reaches a present family bystander when the actor knows of her presence and extreme conduct is highly likely to cause severe distress; specific intent to cause a miscarriage is unnecessary.

Q5651.reason: An as-is clause disclaims implied warranties only and cannot wipe out the express 1964 description or a misrepresentation of the car’s identity.

Q5658.reason: Old upper-lobe TB fibrosis causes unilateral volume loss that pulls the trachea toward the lesion; small effusions, basal pneumonia, and bilateral fibrosis do not.
